correctness.rationale: The proof is correct. Tensor factorization of the normalized hypercube evolution shows every entry at Hamming distance d has magnitude determined by powers of sine and cosine. Diagonal corrections preserve magnitudes, so flat Hadamard magnitudes force the first positive hypercube time nπ/4. At such a time the entrywise Walsh-to-cube ratio factors uniquely into row and column phases indexed by Hamming weight. Any sequence of nonnegative loop-singleton layers of total duration T assigns each vertex an accumulated time between zero and T; modulo a common scalar the required phases therefore need a directed circular arc of length at least π/2 for n=1, π for n=2, and 3π/2 once four weight classes occur. Nested masks attain those costs. Independent exact phase-identity checks through n=8 reproduce the construction, but the all-n proof is analytic.
